question: Does the ~30 % damage dose of the partsheet_tolerance pictures L70 and C70 read rows for both when every damaged patch is moved a full sheet onto the real neighbouring sheet, out of the 2.4 um reader's reach?
window: the same PHerc0841 known-text window W on w00 as partsheet_tolerance

levels.L70d: primary: the dispersed 30 % mask of partsheet L70, every hop moved a full sheet outward along w00's normal (to the centre of the nearest public m7 run 140-250 um out, else a constant 150 um), render offset picked by the p99 rule (+0; p99 rule = of -22 / 0 / +22 layers, the one whose map has the highest 99th percentile inside the valid mask)
levels.C70d: primary: the clustered 30 % mask of partsheet C70, full-sheet hops (same law), offset picked by the p99 rule (-22 layers, about -52.9 um)
levels.L40d: guard: dispersed 60 % full-sheet hops (contains every L70d hop)
levels.H50n: guard: 50 % holes on a new clustered mask, +0
levels.L100: readable control: the undamaged w00 tile (byte copy of partsheet L100)

pictures.calib: calibration: a known-rows ink map of another public fragment's known text (not this window), a picture both raters had rated before
pictures.calib_blank: the calibration map in the wrong layer order (wrong-order blank)

hop_law: each hop vertex moves outward along w00's normal to the centre of the nearest public m7 run lying 140-250 um outward (floor 140 um); if none, a constant 150 um; then Gaussian smoothing sigma 1 vertex. Masks unchanged from the rated partsheet pictures
sitting: rated in one sitting with the fullhop_s022814 / line_spacing page (two pages: the pre-written fallback when the shared page was over 1 MB); each test is scored only on its own pictures

rule.valid_rater: every own picture answered; calibration rows; the calibration blank, L70d blank and C70d blank each not rows; L100 rows

outcomes.FULL-HOP-FAILS: >= 1 valid rater calls L70d or C70d not rows
outcomes.FULL-HOP-HOLDS: both valid raters call rows on both L70d and C70d, AND >= 1 valid rater calls L40d or H50n not rows
outcomes.UNDECIDED (lenient page): both say rows on both primaries and nobody calls a guard not rows

stage0.DARK-HOPS: Stage 0d: off-sheet share of moved vertices > the same vertices on w00 + 0.10 (no page)
stage0.INCONCLUSIVE (reader still reaches): Stage 0b fails at floor 140 and again at the 170 fallback (no page)
stage0.VOID: tile plumbing / mask / coverage checks fail (no page)

rule.stage0b_bar: hop pixels (moved > 50 um): label AUC <= min(blank + 0.05, 0.62), blank = the same deep surface's wrong-order map at the same offset on the same pixels; unmoved pixels: AUC >= the rated parent's AUC - 0.01

wording_if_fails: rows with ~30 % part-sheet displacement (as built from w00); with ~30 % full one-sheet hops, not rows for >= 1 of 2 blind raters
scope: one text window, one picture per level, two raters, one sitting; C70d sat at -22 layers where even the control scores lower

stage0.note: 0c 6/6 tiles pixel-identical, 0m masks, 0d DARK-HOPS pass, coverage 1.0, 0b pass at floor 140 (no fallback)
